content.rationale: S3-new fixes the creation mechanism — a change is opened at a named position change via `jj new -A <position> -m <summary>`, its position and summary given, never defaulted; S3-new-position (N1) fixes which position: the unique head of the given dependency ids, read from jj, so the insertion stays linear even when a dependency already has children; S3-new-position refusal (N2) makes a set with more than one head refuse rather than fork. M-layout places the module flat at src/jj_new.rs. It reads the head from jj, builds the call, and crosses through the runner (M-jj), carrying OpenError { Spawn(String), NonLinear(Vec<String>) }; extracting the new change id is not its concern — kmrmwopx leaves that to the create operation.
